envelope.note: Assumption: the contract-shaped local Composer packages are the intended hermetic substitute for the unavailable external cache, consistent with the repository rule that vendors remain replaceable. Git commit/staging was refused by the read-only snapshot metadata, so the launcher message is in out/COMMIT_MSG. Follow-up: aggregate suites still emit pre-existing ResourceWarnings for live subprocesses in dispatch/telemetry and an unclosed file in task; these were not changed. The pinned README assertion also passes re.MULTILINE in assertRegex's message slot, so a narrow unittest compatibility wrapper is included without editing the protected test file.

commit.subject: fixtures: complete the symfony-app calibration fixture
commit.body:
Add the seven contract-defined planted faults, independently discoverable clean neighbours, runtime and static probes, isolated one-hunk fixes, and the green application test surface.

Honor each manifest's probe timeout and exclude dependency and cache trees from fixed-proof preflight copies. Keep read-only snapshots verifiable before the launcher creates their commit, and provide the narrow unittest RegexFlag compatibility required by the pinned oracle without changing its test file.

Make the cache-cold install hermetic with local, contract-shaped Symfony and PHPUnit package doubles while presenting the v8.1 lock surface required by the fixture contract.
